question: Using data from both the regular season and the post-season, identify the pitcher who achieved the highest non-zero pitch speed for each team by confirming whether the pitcher’s ID appears in the relevant home or away player lists for that game, then retrieve that pitcher’s full name along with the maximum valid pitch speed they achieved while playing for that specific team.
sql:
WITH all_games AS (
  SELECT gameId, seasonType, homeTeamId, homeTeamName, awayTeamId, awayTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_wide`
  WHERE seasonType = 'REG' AND pitchSpeed > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gameId, seasonType, homeTeamId, homeTeamName, awayTeamId, awayTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`
  WHERE seasonType = 'PST' AND pitchSpeed > 0
),
lineups AS (
  SELECT gameId, lineupTeamId, lineupPlayerId, homeTeamId, awayTeamId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_wide`
  WHERE lineupTeamId != '' AND lineupPlayerId != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gameId, lineupTeamId, lineupPlayerId, homeTeamId, awayTeamId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`
  WHERE lineupTeamId != '' AND lineupPlayerId != ''
),
pitcher_teams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ag.gameId, ag.pitcherId, ag.pitcherFirstName, ag.pitcherLastName, ag.pitchSpeed, ag.homeTeamId, ag.homeTeamName, ag.awayTeamId, ag.awayTeamName,
    CASE 
      WHEN l.lineupTeamId = ag.homeTeamId THEN ag.homeTeamId
      WHEN l.lineupTeamId = ag.awayTeamId THEN ag.awayTeamId
      ELSE NULL
    END AS confirmedTeamId,
    CASE 
      WHEN l.lineupTeamId = ag.homeTeamId THEN ag.homeTeamName
      WHEN l.lineupTeamId = ag.awayTeamId THEN ag.awayTeamName
      ELSE NULL
    END AS confirmedTeamName
  FROM all_games ag
  LEFT JOIN lineups l ON ag.gameId = l.gameId AND ag.pitcherId = l.lineupPlayerId
),
team_pitcher_speeds AS (
  SELECT confirmedTeamId, confirmedTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName,
    MAX(pitchSpeed) AS max_speed
  FROM pitcher_teams
  WHERE confirmedTeamId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY confirmedTeamId, confirmedTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT confirmedTeamId, confirmedTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, max_speed,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY confirmedTeamId ORDER BY max_speed DESC) AS rn
  FROM team_pitcher_speeds
)
SELECT confirmedTeamId, confirmedTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, max_speed
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY confirmedTeamName
